summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting ongoing buyback transactions under its previously announced share repurchase program. Between July 30 and August 5, 2026, the bank purchased 17.5 million own shares across XMAD and CEUX venues at weighted average prices ranging from €12.1766 to €12.7466, for a cash outlay of €4,392,508,241, representing 87.3% of the maximum investment amount and about 17.7% of shares outstanding as of 2021. This is a routine periodic disclosure of an ongoing issuer tender-equivalent program, mapped to a US capital return buyback. Watch for completion of the program and share cancellation effects.
